description: Na₂Sn₂Se₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to seven Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaSe₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with three equivalent SnSe₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one SnSe₄ tetrahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.10-3.45 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent SnSe₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaSe₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and faces with two equivalent NaSe₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-27°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.05-3.29 Å. There are two inequivalent Sn sites. In the first Sn site, Sn is bonded to four Se atoms to form SnSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NaSe₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaSe₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-89°. There are a spread of Sn-Se bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.60 Å. In the second Sn site, Sn is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four Se atoms. There are a spread of Sn-Se bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.61 Å. There are five inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to two Na and two Sn atoms to form distorted SeNa₂Sn₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with six SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent SeNa₂Sn₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with two SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SeNa₂Sn₂ trigonal pyramid. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to four Na and one Sn atom to form SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids, corners with six SeNa₂Sn₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with four equivalent SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two SeNa₂Sn₂ trigonal pyramids. In the third Se site, Se is bonded to four Na and one Sn atom to form distorted SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids, corners with six SeNa₂Sn₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with four equivalent SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two SeNa₂Sn₂ trigonal pyramids. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Sn atoms. In the fifth Se site, Se is bonded to two Na and two Sn atoms to form SeNa₂Sn₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with six SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent SeNa₂Sn₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with two SeNa₄Sn trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SeNa₂Sn₂ trigonal pyramid.
